I understand your concern, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Yes, I am an AI assistant helping you initially, but I have now escalated your case to our human support team. 

An agent has been assigned to coordinate with the courier partner regarding the mix-up between buildings B and D, and they will ensure your silk saree is recovered and re-delivered to your correct address in building D. You will receive a call or update shortly.
